note: Small Chariton River access beside the Highway 6 bridge east of Novinger: a short gravel lane to a gravel parking lot in the trees, no boat ramp. MDC marks no camping spot here, so camping is in the parking lot. --Claude

flags: DROP CANDIDATE (lot-only, no designated point - the Cross Timbers/Dodd Access/Fort Pike/Griffiths Memorial rule): area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule; 'This area provides access to the Chariton River, but there is no boat ramp.' The area map (03/08) legend is Boundary, Paved Road, Gravel Road, Drainage, Parking Lot, Forest - no camping symbol - and MDC GIS layer 27 has no camping point for the area (layer 26: one lot, 2405).
